t: Versatile, heavy-duty tool suitable for carpets, flooring, drywall and more. Designed for flooring professionals and other contractors completing the most demanding cutting jobs. Manufactured for durability, and engineered for exceptional cut accuracy, with a hardened steel blade holder. Specially-designed nose to ensure snag-free cutting and minimum blade wobble or movement to helps improve cut speed and reduce wasted material. The blade holder will not wear even in intensive daily use. Featuring optimised ergonomics, in a linear form factor, and delivers maximum blade contact on materials. The extra grip zone recess at the front provides outstanding precision, whilst the enhanced handle grip and tail flare improve control when making longer cuts. Quick-release thumb wheel, and pin-hinged housing, allow for fast and precise blade change, whilst the magnetic nose conveniently holds the blade in place during replacement. Supplied with a protective holster for added safety and easy transportation and onboard storage for 10 x blades with magnetic blade retention.
